Chapter 796: Chapter 14: The Mysterious ‘Map’ (Subscribe Please)

A more distant Boundless Void.

Many watching Foreign Evil Gods almost believed they were witnessing an illusion.

In their view, the Black Demon Pavilion Master and three other powerful Evil Gods were about to attack the Tianqing World.

Suddenly—

They vanished.

Here, ‘vanished’ means completely disappeared, without even a trace of their aura perceptible.

...

“What’s going on?”

“Where are the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the others?”

“Why did they just disappear?”

Initially, the Foreign Evil Gods instinctively questioned.

But moments later, more and more of them realized.

Either the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the three others had been completely suppressed, or they had already fallen.

Otherwise, there wouldn’t be such an inexplicable disappearance without any signs.

This speculation made every Foreign Evil God’s scalp explode.

When ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Touch Stream’ were trapped in the Tianqing World, they could still understand what was happening.

‘Myriad Touch Stream’ was extinguished, directly suppressed; ‘Demonic Eye’ tried to escape, but half of its body was pulled back by a giant hand that extended from within the Tianqing World.

But what about the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the three powerful Evil Gods?

What happened?

All the Foreign Evil Gods could not understand what had exactly happened.

What’s more critical is that, compared to ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Touch Stream,’ the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the other three were unimaginably more powerful. Their silent disappearance without even causing a ripple deeply chilled the other Foreign Evil Gods.

…

Inside Tianqing World.

Countless Martial Dao Cultivators were celebrating the salvation brought by Martial Ancestor.

Thanks to the propaganda of Martial Hall, all beings within the world knew that it was their revered Martial Ancestor, whom they had worshiped for hundreds of thousands of years, who had dealt with the existence of ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Touch Stream.’

However.

What the beings inside the Tianqing World did not know was that just recently, the Black Demon Pavilion Master and other three beings far surpassing the earlier two Evil Gods were also casually dealt with by Martial Ancestor.

The whole process did not cause any disturbance.

The Black Demon Pavilion Master and the three powerful Evil Gods, in the presence of Lin Yuan, did not even have the ability to struggle or resist.

…

Deep within Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan was carefully understanding every detail of when he had used the Divine Ability ‘World.’

“That instant, the Divine Ability imprint used my physical body as the base, connecting in all directions, forcibly turning everything in the Boundless Void into my ‘World’…”

Lin Yuan was somewhat shocked.

Compared to Secret Techniques, activating a Divine Ability does not require comprehension; Lin Yuan only needs to stimulate the imprint representing the Divine Ability ‘World’ inside him.

Of course.

If Lin Yuan could fully understand the imprint of the ‘World’ Divine Ability, it would mean transforming this ability into a form of Secret Technique that he can comprehend, thus enabling him to bring it to the Main Universe and use it with his true Primordial Spirit.

“I feel that with each use of the Divine Ability ‘World,’ my understanding of its ‘imprint’ deepens, bringing me closer to full comprehension.”

Lin Yuan thought pensively.

Directly viewing the ‘World’ Divine Ability imprint to understand it fully is indeed something Lin Yuan can achieve with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, but actively stimulating this Divine Ability and observing its interaction with the surrounding heaven and earth more evidently accelerates the comprehension.

“Activating the ‘World’ Divine Ability once consumes a lot of energy. With my current strength, without affecting my powers, I can probably activate it once every two days.”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

“It’s a pity, the power generated from self-destruction is just too great, otherwise, I could have tried it.”

Lin Yuan felt a bit regretful.

Even now, with his Inner World unenhanced by the Mysterious Gourd or infused with the Chaos Void, once self-destructing, the generated power would be extremely terrifying.

The mere aftermath could potentially penetrate the Tianqing World, and if Lin Yuan attempted to self-destruct outside his body, he would need to choose a location far from the Tianqing World.

“Next, I can use a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force to summon the Mysterious Gourd, enhancing this physical body’s Inner World and resilience.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He wanted to see what it felt like to execute the ‘World’ Divine Ability again after his Inner World reached an expanse of over two billion square miles.

…

“Right.”

Lin Yuan seemed to recall something and his Consciousness Descended into his Inner World.

The Black Demon Pavilion Master and the other three Foreign Evil Gods were completely suppressed. Their gigantic bodies were reduced to a few meters in size, lying in a corner asleep.

“These four nearly Tenth Rank Evil Gods do hold significant research value.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts flickered slightly. Most of the bodies of the four Foreign Evil Gods were transformed into Origin Power and absorbed by the Inner World.

To study the Foreign Evil Gods, only their core parts were needed.

Rustling…

As their bodies crumbled,

the treasures carried by the four Foreign Evil Gods spilled out all over.

Lin Yuan casually inspected them, and indeed, as the powerful Evil God who had dominated this region, the Black Demon Pavilion Master’s treasures were all of notable value.

Powerful Weapons?

Special metals.

Rare Spirit Fruit.

And so forth.

The other three Evil Gods also held considerable wealth, only slightly less than the Black Demon Pavilion Master.

Although bringing these treasures back to the Main Universe would cost World-Breaking Origin Force, Lin Yuan could cleverly transform them into Primal Force and integrate them within the Origin Clock, thereby indirectly taking them back to the Main Universe.

As for the Martial Ancestor Golden Body that Lin Yuan now possessed? Unlike the physical body he had used to traverse other worlds before, Lin Yuan did not plan to transform this body into Primal Force and merge it into the Origin Clock.

The Tianqing World had already become Lin Yuan’s backyard, where descending once only required a third of a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force, meaning that as long as Lin Yuan wished, he could descend at any time.

In such a situation, Lin Yuan needed a physical body always ready, to avoid going through the recovery phase every time he descended.

For instance, this time when he descended into the Tianqing World, it took Lin Yuan less than four days to recover to the Tenth Stage Martial Tao.

If this were in other traversed worlds? At least it would be calculated in decades or even centuries.

…

Whoosh.

The accumulation of the four Outer Domain Evil Gods over millions or even tens of millions of years, though most of it was used on themselves, the remaining treasures were still vast like an ocean.

Lin Yuan quickly inventoried the spoils previously obtained from suppressing the ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Touch Stream’, which were far inferior to what he now had.

“Good grief, this piece of special metal, similar to the ‘Taiyang Gold Crystal’ of the Main Universe, such a large piece containing the power of Taiyang True Fire could be estimated to have as much as ten thousand stars. Even within human civilization, it would be considered an Eleven-Star Rare Treasure.”

Lin Yuan waved his right hand, and a fist-sized red crystal core appeared in front of him.

This crystal core did not seem big, but it was the result of Lin Yuan using the Space Rules to compress it. If not compressed, its size was estimated to exceed a million miles.

“The dimension where the Boundless Void is located, and the dimension where Chaos Void is located, are not the same dimension, and the treasures within them vary in value.”

“This Taiyang Gold Core, under extremely harsh conditions for formation in the Main Universe, requires millions of years to hope to develop; but in this Boundless Void?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Not to mention different dimensions, even within the same dimension in different universes, many resource cultivation conditions differ.

The difficulty of nurturing certain resources varies from universe to universe.

This is even more so between dimensions.

Of course.

Whether it was the dimension of the Boundless Void or that of the Chaos Void, although they are not in the same dimension, they essentially belong to the same type of space; both are three-dimensional spaces.

Thus, all the rules Lin Yuan had comprehended could be applied.

If he was in a lower dimension, such as a two-dimensional space, it would trap him in the scenario like the ‘Blank Paper’ Two-Dimensional World of the Main Universe.

It would even be more brutal than the Two-Dimensional World.

The Two-Dimensional World is almost a perfect world, a product of life exploring low-dimensional space, merely mimicking low-dimensional space and clearly different from true low-dimensional space.

…

Lin Yuan quickly inventoried the spoils, merely having killed four nearly Tenth Stage Outer Domain Evil Gods, but the richness of the spoils gave Lin Yuan the illusion of having killed an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse’s True Body.

You should know that in the Main Universe, completely killing an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse is a very difficult task, as those Eleventh Rank Powerhouses all hide their true bodies in absolutely safe places.

What about Avatars? They do not carry too precious treasures, and even if killed, the gain wouldn’t be big.

Like the Four Divine Kings, whose avatars merged into the ultimate weapons, it is exceedingly rare, prepared by the Star Alliance as trump cards, intended to go on a killing spree on the battlefield.

And holding weapons that suit themselves, with the ultimate existence not taking action, who else could kill them?

…

Whoosh whoosh whoosh.

One by one, the spoils were categorized by Lin Yuan; whether to absorb them now or later, each was properly arranged according to its location.

Suddenly.

Lin Yuan stopped.

He looked towards a ‘scroll’.

This scroll should be a scroll hanging in the air, seemingly quite ordinary.

But how could a treasure collected by four evil gods be ordinary? Moreover, this scroll made Lin Yuan somewhat unable to see through it; he could not discern the fundamental nature of the scroll.

“Even the power of the world cannot penetrate it?”

Lin Yuan looked shocked. Lin Yuan’s method to appraise a spoil was through the infiltration of the World’s Power, and then measuring its value with it.

This was the simplest method.

But now, the World’s Power could not infiltrate this scroll in front of him.

Without infiltration, naturally, the inside value could not be measured.

“This scroll comes from the Black Demon Pavilion Master.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, carefully examining it.

“Interesting.”

Lin Yuan looked at the scroll floating in front of him.

“Forget it.”

“Directly Soul Search.”

Lin Yuan caught the soul of the Black Demon Pavilion Master and began to Soul Search.

“This scroll, obtained by chance by the Black Demon Pavilion Master, is a ‘key’ to a Void Secret Realm, merging consciousness into it… Hmm?”

Lin Yuan furrowed his brow slightly.

In the memory of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, there wasn’t a segment about merging consciousness into the scroll.

This situation could have two possibilities.

One is that the Black Demon Pavilion Master actively erased this memory.

But this possibility is quite low, as the Black Demon Pavilion Master did not know that he would fall into Lin Yuan’s hands and, without prior knowledge, would not erase the memory.

The second possibility is that the scroll cannot be recalled in memory.

That is, only the person himself knows, and others, even if they Soul Search, cannot see.

Some core heritage secret methods of human civilization use this method to prevent being known by different species.

“I will merge my consciousness into it and take a look.”

Lin Yuan repeatedly confirmed, although he could not know the scene of the Black Demon Pavilion Master’s consciousness merging into the scroll, from the memories of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, there was no aversion to merging consciousness into it.

There was even some anticipation.

This meant there was no danger.

Boom!

Lin Yuan’s consciousness merged into the scroll.

He suddenly entered a space.
